quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 net sales of JPY 732.3 billion rose 2.9% quarter-over-quarter and gross profit of JPY 342.7 billion rose 2.9% - both record highs. Gross profit margin was 46.8% (flat QoQ), operating income JPY 211.4 billion (+2.8% QoQ) at a 28.9% operating margin. Net income fell 23.3% QoQ to JPY 164.3 billion only because the previous quarter included extraordinary income from selling strategic shareholdings. By region, Taiwan sales increased 18.9% sequentially to 25.4% of total, and China was 30.4% of sales (expected at the low 30s% level for full-year FY2027). SPE new equipment sales by application: DRAM 32%, non-volatile memory 11% (up 32% QoQ), non-memory 57%. Field solutions sales rose 15.5% sequentially to JPY 188.0 billion on high customer fab utilization, with used equipment and modifications up 20.5% QoQ. Free cash flow was JPY 80.5 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 net sales JPY 732.3 billion (+2.9% QoQ, record); gross margin 46.8%; operating income JPY 211.4 billion (28.9% margin); net income JPY 164.3 billion (-23.3% QoQ); field solutions JPY 188.0 billion (+15.5% QoQ)

quarterly_data.signal: WFE market outlook raised from the April projection to $150 billion or more in CY2026 and $190 billion or more in CY2027, with 20% or more year-over-year growth expected in both years (management acknowledged analyst consensus near $200 billion for 2027 but said real capacity and distribution constraints make $190 billion or more the appropriate view). CY2026 WFE composition: DRAM low $40 billion range (+30% or more YoY), NAND low to mid $10 billion range (+40% or more YoY), logic and foundry mid $80 billion range (+15% or more YoY), factory automation and wafer-level packaging about $10 billion. Tokyo Electron raised its first-half FY2027 estimate to net sales of JPY 1 trillion, 620 billion, gross profit JPY 748 billion and operating income JPY 458 billion - all half-year records - and is getting more confident of JPY 3 trillion or more in full-year sales, with operating income of JPY 1 trillion expected within this fiscal year. First-half SPE new equipment sales are expected to grow 45% year-over-year to JPY 1 trillion, 240 billion, with Q2 new equipment sales expected to hit a quarterly record topping JPY 700 billion. Interim dividend raised to a record JPY 384 per share; FY2027 plan holds R&D at JPY 330 billion and CapEx at JPY 190 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: WFE $150 billion or more CY2026, $190 billion or more CY2027 (both +20% or more); H1 FY2027 sales JPY 1 trillion, 620 billion; full-year JPY 3 trillion or more; H1 new equipment +45% YoY to JPY 1 trillion, 240 billion; Q2 topping JPY 700 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Strong AI server demand is producing pull-in requests for delivery and additional orders from customers, and price revisions are being negotiated with multiple customers - applied to existing models as well - with considerable impact expected in the fourth quarter of FY2027. Management aims for gross profit margin of 50% or more within around two years (could be reached in the early stage of next fiscal year) and maintains the 35% operating margin mid-term target. On capacity: the new Miyagi innovative production center (smart fab, completion next summer) can increase capacity by 3 times, and the timing is being accelerated to meet market growth; Tokyo Electron delivers 4,000 to 6,000 units per year and is working to cut equipment startup time by half. The July 28 Kumamoto earthquake closed coater developer, cleaning and bonding system sites in Koshi City, but all employees are safe, no building damage was identified, full operation was expected early the following week, and impacts on business performance are minor - etch systems, deposition systems and probers made outside Kumamoto are unaffected. Epsira (announced December 2025) is the digital infrastructure to raise field productivity, and Tokyo Electron announced expansion of its collaboration with NVIDIA this month to develop solutions for agentic AI and robotics.
quarterly_data.figure: Gross margin target 50% or more within around two years; Miyagi smart fab to lift capacity by 3 times; 4,000 to 6,000 units delivered per year; Kumamoto earthquake impact minor

quarterly_data.signal: Product momentum in FY2027: coater developer (share of more than 90% across EUV to immersion lithography) won PORs in multiple processes in advanced logic and DRAM with the new Resive Pro Dice; full-year etch system sales of JPY 1 trillion are coming within reach; cryogenic etch systems for 400-layer NAND start deploying in customers' mass production lines from calendar 2027; a POR was won for a new low resistance metal deposition system in a new application area. For DRAM interconnect etch, five-year cumulative sales to fiscal 2030 are getting closer to JPY 1 trillion, significantly exceeding the original guidance of JPY 500 billion. In advanced packaging, prober sales show outstanding growth with full-year sales likely to go significantly beyond JPY 100 billion, and the Prexa SDP device prober for advanced logic launched in April; bonder/debonder and 3D-IC are growth areas combining leading-edge front-end and bonding technology.
quarterly_data.figure: Coater developer share more than 90%; etch sales JPY 1 trillion full-year within reach; DRAM interconnect etch five-year cumulative sales near JPY 1 trillion vs JPY 500 billion original guidance; prober sales significantly beyond JPY 100 billion; cryogenic etch for 400 layers in mass production from calendar 2027

quarterly_data.signal: AI data center applications drive the WFE market: sales to AI data center are expected to grow by five times or more in the five years from calendar 2023 through calendar 2027, spanning not only GPU and HBM but also DDR, CPU and 3D NAND. Technology transitions expected within two years: logic scaling from the 3 nanometer mainstream toward 2 nanometer with backside PDN adoption, DRAM evolving to the 1D node (1C to 1D transition), HBM stacked DRAM count rising from 12 to 16, and NAND evolving to 300 layers and further to 400 layers. Agentic AI is the driver of the overall WFE market; CY2026 WFE application mix is about 60% logic and 40% memory, versus 65%/35% last year.
quarterly_data.figure: AI data center WFE sales to grow five times or more CY2023-CY2027; HBM stacks from 12 to 16; NAND to 300 then 400 layers; logic mainstream 3 nanometer moving to 2 nanometer
